Name: Roachie - A Lovable Companion
Author: Willowtail27
Description:
This is a simple mod that replaces the cat with a roach and was made for personal reasons.  You may ask why that I made a mod that turns the cat into a roach? Well you see, one of my own OCs have a giant pet roach as their own companion so I thought for my first mod I would add it to Stardew Valley.

THANK YOU Minakie FOR THE CP!

[b]How to Install
[/b]Unzip the file under Stardew Valley/Content/Animals and overwrite the files with the new files from the mod.

Downloads.Description: Just place in your mod folder and run with SMPAI
